notes.title: The Cinematic Video is Now Live!
notes.content:
**{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190626/55f29a6e482290c4acf6f3a0ab4aa8984a2a2c9a.png
We are excited to share with you the new trailer for our game, Madness of the Science! In this trailer, you will discover the intense world of our story-driven FPS game, where you, as the sole surviving scientist of a laboratory explosion, will battle against mutants and malfunctioning AI robots.

Don’t forget to watch the trailer and experience this thrilling adventure firsthand! ⬇️
https://youtu.be/_1DdJD9nPKM**

Don't Forget to Add to Your Wishlist!
Be sure to check out our game on Steam and add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207800/Madness_of_the_Science/

Community:
Also, feel free to join our Discord community!

Stay tuned, goodbye!
